_comment: Map each company slug to its investor-relations / reports page(s). Copy this file to report_watcher.config.json and edit. List BOTH the quarterly-results and annual-reports pages to capture full-year history; pair with `watch --max-years 5`. 'patterns' (optional) are extra regexes (matched case-insensitively against the URL) on top of the built-in report patterns. 'domains' (optional) restricts downloads to these registrable domains — the watcher only ever fetches from official IR domains (plus the CDN hosts the page links files to); if omitted, the domains are derived from the 'urls' above. National regulators live separately in regulators.json (see README).
